background.treatment: Two blurred radial orbs (navy top-right, gold bottom-left) + faint 70px grid masked with a radial gradient + oversized outline tooth, bottom-right.

visual.replacement_instruction: Overwrite assets/hero.jpg (keep the name) or change the src in index.html. Nothing is hard-coded in CSS or JS.
visual.decoration: Dashed circle ring behind the top-right corner (74% width).

floating_elements.content: Good quality treatment in affordable prices. — Patient Review

rules: Hero stacks: content first, visual second.
Image frame keeps 4/5 aspect, visual capped at 400px wide (460px from 640px).
Rating badge stays anchored top-left of the image at reduced size.
Testimonial and trust cards leave the absolute flow and stack under the image at full width — no overlap of readable content.
